project: QoS-Aware Encrypted Traffic Classification for Next-Generation Networks

leak_free_guarantees.group_kfold: StratifiedGroupKFold partitions groups strictly. No capture group exists in both train and validation folds.
leak_free_guarantees.preprocessing: Imputation, VarianceThreshold, Collinearity elimination, and StandardScaler must be fitted exclusively on the training fold, then transformed on the validation fold.
leak_free_guarantees.oversampling_policy: NO oversampling or SMOTE is permitted in baseline preparation. Class imbalance is handled via loss weighting and algorithm-native class_weight parameters.
leak_free_guarantees.hyperparameter_policy: Hyperparameter tuning must occur strictly inside nested cross-validation or on training partitions only.

step_1_variance_threshold.name: Zero-Variance Feature Dropper
step_1_variance_threshold.rationale: Removes features with zero variance on the training fold (e.g., tcp_urg_count with std=0.0).

step_2_collinearity_filter.name: Perfect Collinearity Filter
step_2_collinearity_filter.rationale: Drops redundant duplicate features (e.g., bwd_burst_count which has r=1.0000 with fwd_burst_count).

step_3_scaling.name: Standard Scaler
step_3_scaling.rationale: Standardizes features by removing the mean and scaling to unit variance.

random_forest.handling_class_imbalance: class_weight='balanced' weights inversely proportional to class frequencies.
random_forest.input_requirements: Requires unscaled or scaled features; robust to monotonic transformations.

xgboost.handling_class_imbalance: Per-sample weights computed on the training fold as w_c = N / (K * N_c) and passed to fit(sample_weight=...).
xgboost.input_requirements: Requires numeric features; handles non-linear relationships.

p_mlp.differentiation_from_huang_2021: Huang et al. (2021) deployed raw byte-level 1D-CNN and LSTM architectures directly on payload byte slices. Our QoS-aware P-MLP strictly respects end-to-end payload encryption and privacy by operating exclusively on flow-level statistical and temporal packet dynamics without payload inspection.

primary.justification: Primary metric due to class imbalance (6.3:1 in Track A, 6.3:1 in Track B). Treats each class with equal importance, preventing majority class bias.

secondary.justification: Calculates macro-average of recall across all classes, avoiding optimistic accuracy illusions on skewed distributions.
